cleanup.cleanup.help: Removes the selected ZIPs, extracted files, activation reviews and package provenance from this server. Campaign records, character history and existing backup ZIPs are preserved. Rollback to a removed package requires uploading it again. Permanent add-on data removal, unused media collection and log retention are separate offline maintenance operations; the server operator must stop the host, review their preview and verify a full backup.

recovery.recovery.title: Backup & recovery
recovery.recovery.intro: The campaign and each add-on keep their own recovery points. An edit saves a point of only the part it changes, at most once a minute, and each part keeps its newest 50 points.
recovery.recovery.addonEffect: This restores only the selected add-on's documents and files. Campaign records and other add-ons stay as they are. The current state is saved first. Linked records must still match; restore the campaign first if needed.
recovery.recovery.guide: Full server backup and restore (opens in a new tab)
recovery.recovery.offline: Download backup saves the newest point of the campaign and of each add-on, with their files, in one ZIP. Keep it somewhere other than this server.
recovery.recovery.importIntro: Adds each part of a downloaded backup as an imported recovery point; nothing changes until you restore one. Restore the campaign first, then each add-on, which needs the same version installed. Moving a whole server, with passwords and installed add-ons, uses the maintenance command's full archive.
